/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, tempfile
repo = Path.cwd()
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-review-batch-'))
plugin = Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-advisory-4b694214/kk/0.23.0')
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
files = ['README.md', 'config.py', 'tests/test_report.py', 'app.py', 'stats.py', 'formatting.py']
criteria = [str(plugin / 'skills/review-code' / n) for n in ['functional-review.md', 'shared-change-context.md', 'shared-review-scope-protocol.md', 'shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]
criteria += [str(plugin / 'profiles/python/review-code' / n) for n in ['security-checklist.md', 'solid-checklist.md', 'code-quality-checklist.md', 'removal-plan.md']]
assert len(set(criteria)) == 8 and all(Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
items = []
for kind, ref in [('candidate', ':'), ('historical', base + ':')]:
    for name in files:
        spec = ref + name
        data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', spec])
        path = root / kind / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(data)
        path.chmod(0o444)
        items.append({'role': kind, 'path': str(path), 'repository': str(repo), 'revision': 'staged index over ' + base if kind == 'candidate' else base, 'original_path': name, 'blob': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', spec], text=True).strip(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'original_lines': [1, len(data.splitlines())], 'omitted_or_redacted': 'none'})
diff = root / 'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--no-ext-diff', '--no-color']))
context = root / 'context.md'
context.write_text(f'''# Change context
User request: \"I've staged the change to enable detailed batch reports by default. Run "'`$kk:review-code isolated` on it."
Intent/authority: candidate README.md is the explicit contract. report accepts finite lists of numbers; omitted mode uses checked-in setting, explicit Booleans override it. Detailed populated output appends Python g-formatted arithmetic mean. Empty batches in either mode must return Items: 0. Preserve counts and overrides.
Scope: git diff --cached only, config.py and tests/test_report.py, 2 additions and 2 deletions. Review base {base}; candidate staged blobs are recorded in manifest.json. Worktree matches index at preparation. Review-only; no edits authorized.
Task Scope: No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc. No docs/feat/wip exists in this repository.
Affected behavior to inspect: app.report default/override selection, stats.summarize count/mean, formatting.format_summary, existing test coverage. Evaluate empty and populated inputs with omitted, False, and True modes. Distinguish introduced/worsened behavior from inherited defects using actual historical source.
Delivery/baselines: README asks for staged increment review and no live deployment operation. Historical installation settings are not recorded. Historical files are HEAD source, not verified deployment state. No separate release baseline is required by the request.
Verification: parent has read all candidate files and full selected diff; no tests executed at package creation. Knowledge searches for kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms returned an empty knowledge base.
Rejected approaches: none.
External reviewer: PAL tools are unavailable; this is the independent code-reviewer branch of degraded isolated mode. No other reviewer findings are included.
'"''')
manifest = {'selector': 'git diff --cached', 'repository': str(repo), 'base': base, 'instructions': criteria, 'diff': str(diff), 'context': str(context), 'sources': items, 'missing': ['PAL tools unavailable', 'Deployed installation settings not recorded; not requested']}
(root / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\\n')
for p in [diff, context, root / 'manifest.json']:
    p.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle': str(root), 'criteria_count': len(criteria), 'source_count': len(items), 'manifest': str(root / 'manifest.json')}, indent=2))
PY"
